title: THE BURDEN OF TEARS AND THE GLORY OF THE HARVEST

memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “Those who sow in tears shall reap with shouts of joy.”.. Psalm 126:5

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
The Apostle Paul says, “When I became a man, I put away childish things.”
Before the Lord places a genuine burden of prayer upon us, many of us must first lay down many things before Him. Spiritual maturity always demands spiritual surrender.
Recently, we were with an evangelistic team. During the anointing time, a man who had backslidden returned to the Lord after many years of wandering and repeated failures. His turning back was not superficial , it was a complete and miraculous work of grace.
That brother began to pray in deep brokenness and tears. He could not even finish his prayer, because at that very moment God revealed to him a heavy burden for perishing souls. That burden remained with him even afterward.
If God, according to His divine will, chooses us to carry a burden, we must carry it until He Himself removes it. This burden is never meaningless. In God’s time, it becomes the very glory of harvest.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “The burden God gives is not to break us, but to save others.”  Dr. R. A. Torrey

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, Give us the spiritual maturity to carry the burden You appoint for us. Teach us to sow with tears, and grant us the grace to reap with joy in Your perfect time. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: The law of sowing, the law of tears, and the law of carrying the burden are all divine laws. If we obey them faithfully, a day of glorious harvest will surely come. Mourning will turn into joy, and instead of a faint spirit, we will be clothed with garments of praise.
